claim_rule: Only baseline issue metrics may appear in claims. Topic rollups and corrected sensitivity values must be described separately and never exported as claims.
dataset_limits: Historical self-selected app reviews are not the complete customer population.
No revenue, plan tier, confirmed cancellation, or causal retention data is available.
Cancellation language is expressed intent, not observed churn.
Issue-level sensitivity correction cannot allocate predicted non-complaints into a latent issue.
The adopted grouping retains low_coherence issues even after one bounded split.

I_ACCESS_01.description: Most users report being unable to log in, with one report of unexpected new-device login emails.

I_ACCESS_02.description: Users report being unable to log in or regain access to their accounts and saved music.

I_ACCESS_03.description: Users say they cannot log in to their account, without identifying a specific sign-in method or error.

I_BILLING_01.description: Reviewers say free-plan users are being asked to upgrade to Premium to play chosen songs or use song controls such as seeking and changing tracks.
I_BILLING_01.issue_name: Premium required for song choice and controls

I_BILLING_02.description: Users say premium prompts and paywalls make the app feel increasingly unusable or irritating.

I_BILLING_03.description: Users say many features or basic use now require Premium, making the free version feel too limited.

I_BILLING_04.description: Most examples complain that updates moved basic features behind the premium paywall; two discuss a free trial or value instead.

I_CATALOG_01.description: Lyrics fail to appear or load for songs where users expect them to be available.

I_CATALOG_02.description: Users report that songs or complete albums, including local artists' releases, are missing or cannot be found in the catalog.
I_CATALOG_02.issue_name: Songs or albums missing from catalog

I_CATALOG_03.description: Examples mix unwanted recommendations or autoplay, limited song selection, and dissatisfaction with the algorithm or home page.

I_DOWNLOADS_01.description: Downloaded tracks may disappear, fail to play offline, or repeatedly require downloading again.
I_DOWNLOADS_01.issue_name: Downloaded tracks disappear or fail offline

I_DOWNLOADS_02.description: Downloaded music sometimes fails to appear or play offline, or the app incorrectly reports that the user is offline.

I_DOWNLOADS_03.description: Users report difficulty downloading or playing music offline, mixed with access expectations, download speed, and family account limitations.

I_DOWNLOADS_04.description: Most examples express general dislike or advise against downloading the app, while one specifically says downloads fail.

I_OTHER_01.description: Reviews express general dislike of the app, with few details about a specific product problem.

I_OTHER_02.description: The examples express nonspecific negative judgments without identifying a particular product problem.

I_OTHER_03.description: Most examples give generic negative reactions, while a few mention political or religious content without a clear shared product problem.

I_OTHER_04.description: Most examples express dissatisfaction with an unspecified update, while one cites a price increase and cancellation.

I_OTHER_05.description: Most examples are generic insults, while others mention recent poor service or bugs without enough detail to identify a specific problem.

I_PLAYBACK_01.description: Most users report lag, slow loading, or playback interruptions, while one reports connectivity errors despite working internet.

I_PLAYBACK_02.description: Playback unexpectedly pauses or stops during or between songs and may require restarting playback or the app.

I_PLAYBACK_03.description: Playback can stop, crash, or fail to continue, often after switching apps; one example instead reports a missing podcast option.

I_PLAYBACK_04.description: Reviews mix unwanted suggested-song playback with interruptions, update-related bugs, and other playback complaints.

I_PLAYBACK_05.description: Examples combine playback failures and interruptions with complaints about mobile playback restrictions and being directed to unwanted songs.
I_PLAYBACK_05.issue_name: Songs fail to play as expected

I_PLAYBACK_06.description: Reports mix poor audio quality with excessive advertising, high data use, and unrelated complaints, so the examples do not describe one consistent problem.

I_PLAYBACK_07.description: Reviews mainly report instability, crashes, lag, or slow startup when using the app.

I_PLAYBACK_08.description: Selecting a song or artist starts different music, a suggested track, or a playlist instead of the requested selection.

I_PLAYBACK_09.description: Most examples report a false offline status despite working internet, while a few describe general loading, startup, or regional access failures.

I_SUPPORT_01.description: Examples vary between successful and unsuccessful support experiences, with one focused on difficulty unsubscribing.

I_SUPPORT_02.description: Most examples say support is unavailable or unresponsive, while others describe helpful support or unrelated assistance.
I_SUPPORT_02.issue_name: Hard to reach or unresponsive support

I_SUPPORT_03.description: Users give a general negative assessment of customer service without specifying a particular failure.

I_SUPPORT_04.description: Most examples describe poor or unavailable support in general terms, while one concerns disagreement with a price increase.

I_SUPPORT_05.description: Customers report difficulty reaching support or getting useful, safe help to resolve app problems.

I_SUPPORT_06.description: Reviews largely accuse Spotify of supporting bullies and demand an apology, without identifying a product issue.
I_SUPPORT_06.issue_name: Objection to alleged support for bullying

I_SUPPORT_07.description: The examples mix unresolved support cases and response praise with complaints about free service, spam, and subscription security.

I_SUPPORT_08.description: Examples mix difficult or ineffective support with successful resolutions and unrelated playlist and account problems.

I_SUPPORT_09.description: Most examples report ineffective or frustrating customer service, while one praises support and another is a broad complaint about customer care.

I_USABILITY_01.description: Users report excessive ads and problems with recent updates, including removed features, slow performance, broken scrolling, and missing songs.

I_USABILITY_02.description: Users say recent updates changed the interface or removed basic features and request restoration of the previous experience.
I_USABILITY_02.issue_name: Recent updates removed features or worsened the interface

I_USABILITY_03.description: Users report frequent or intrusive ads interrupting music playback, including complaints that an ad-free option still includes ads.

I_USABILITY_04.description: Users object to limits on song selection and playlist playback, including shuffle behavior and controls that they say require Premium.
I_USABILITY_04.issue_name: Playlist playback and song selection limits

limitations: The verifier is an independent model pass, not human ground truth.
The local stratum has 300 distinct texts; sparse cells depend on smoothing.
Bootstrap intervals represent verifier-sample uncertainty under this correction model, not total model uncertainty.
Issue corrections cannot recover false-negative complaints into a specific issue because they were never grouped.
These corrected estimates are sensitivity outputs and are not claims.csv evidence.

luna.interpretation: same-model Luna test-retest, not independent accuracy
